events.title: Orange object over Palmerston North seen by band member
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A band member walking from the Lowes? Motel/Bar area near the Albert Hotel, Palmerston North, wrote the report.

**Sighting:** At about 10:30 pm on Thursday night, while crossing the carpark, he and companions noticed an unusual object in the sky.

**Object:** An "orange ball" estimated at roughly 5,000 ft, about 45° above them, appearing to burn, with jagged changing edges and a pulsing color from pale to darker orange.

**Tactics:** It drifted south, then seemed to move side-to-side very rapidly and without normal turning, with a small dip and return to its prior line of travel.

**Note:** The object remained visible for about 5–7 minutes before fading; when they turned back, they also saw three nosecones in a shallow V formation in the same area.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名乐队成员在写信报告此事，地点在帕默斯顿北（Palmerston North）附近。

**目击：** 周四夜晚约10:30，他和同伴在穿过停车场时，注意到天空中有一个异常物体。

**物体：** 这是一个“橙色球体”，估计高度约5,000英尺，仰角约45°；它看起来像在燃烧，边缘锯齿状并不断变化，颜色在浅橙与深橙之间脉动。

**动作：** 它向南移动，随后似乎以很快速度左右摆动，且没有正常的转弯动作，还会轻微下沉再回到原来的轨迹。

**备注：** 该物体持续可见约5–7分钟后变得太远而无法用肉眼看清；当他们转身回去时，还在同一方向看到三个“机鼻形”物体呈浅V字队形。

events.title: Orange disc over Palmerston North
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** An RNZAF Duty Operations Officer at Ohakea was contacted on 26 April 1979 about reports from Palmerston North residents; the writer later described his own observation and sought additional witnesses.

**Sighting:** On the evening of 20 April 1979, a light/“disc” was seen moving over Palmerston North, first from north to south, then later appearing stationary before moving away.

**Object:** Described as a single orange/yellow light or disc with a red corona; at one point it seemed to grow smaller, as if climbing rapidly, and later reportedly emitted sparks.

**Tactics:** The object crossed the city, changed apparent direction, and disappeared into the stars; a radar check at Wellington Air Traffic Control found no known traffic or unidentified blip.

**Note:** The account is a multi-witness report compiled from calls and follow-up interviews, not a contactee narrative.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 1979年4月26日，Ohakea 的 RNZAF 值班行动官接到电话，得知 Palmerston North 居民的报告；作者随后描述了自己的目击并寻找其他证人。

**目击：** 1979年4月20日晚，有人看到一个光点/“圆盘”在 Palmerston North 上空移动，最初似乎由北向南，之后又显得静止不动并再度移动。

**物体：** 被描述为单一的橙色/黄色光点或圆盘，外有红色光晕；一度看起来变小，像是快速爬升，后来据称还发出火花。

**轨迹：** 该物体穿过城市，改变了表观方向，最后消失在星空中；Wellington 空中交通管制雷达检查未发现已知航班或异常回波。

**注：** 这是根据电话与后续访谈整理的多证人报告，不是接触者叙述。

events.title: Three orange discs observed near Ashhurst
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A witness in Tawa, Wellington, passed on an initial report concerning a sighting by a family group in Ashhurst, Palmerston North.

**Sighting:** At about 2300 hours on 26 April 1979, the witnesses observed aerial phenomena.

**Object:** Three orange discs of light were seen in a shallow V formation, travelling on a roughly northward course over the local horizon.

**Tactics:** The objects flew together briefly and then disappeared from sight.

**Note:** The page is an appendix-style record and includes routing notes, but it does describe a concrete sighting event with date, place, witnesses, and observed behavior.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名来自惠灵顿 Tawa 的目击者转述了 Ashhurst（Palmerston North）一家人的目击报告。

**目击：** 1979年4月26日约2300时，目击者看到空中现象。

**物体：** 看到三个橙色光盘状物体呈浅 V 字队形飞行，航向大致朝北，掠过当地地平线。

**行为：** 这些物体短暂并行飞行后消失在视野中。

**备注：** 这一页带有附件/转递性质内容，但它确实记录了一个具体事件，包含日期、地点、目击者和观察细节。

events.title: UFO reported west of Palmerston North
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** S/L G. Allen at Ohakea reported the sighting by telephone to the Ohakea Operations Flight Commander and the duty Operations Officer. The summary also notes other observers from a family group and two nearby civilians.

**Sighting:** At about 2300 on 21 April 1979, a UFO was seen over the Palmerston North area, roughly 8 miles away over the mountain range along the watershed. It traveled on a SSW course and was later tracked to the west/northwest of Palmerston North.

**Object:** It was described as similar in appearance, course, and pattern to an earlier sighting; it maintained a steady position before slowly receding.

**Tactics:** The object ceased motion at about 2302, then gradually moved on a 130°T bearing, remained steady until about 2305, and then receded into the star background.

**Note:** This page is a minute-sheet summary of a fuller report, but it clearly records a concrete sighting event.
events.report_summary_zh:
**见证人：** Ohakea 的 S/L G. Allen 通过电话向 Ohakea 行动飞行指挥官和值班行动官报告了这次目击。摘要还提到还有一个家庭群体中的 3 名目击者以及 2 名附近平民。

**目击：** 1979年4月21日约2300时，在 Palmerston North 地区上空看见一个 UFO，距离约8英里，位于山脉/分水岭一带。其飞行方向为西南偏南（SSW），随后被描述为在 Palmerston North 西北/西侧方向。

**物体：** 该物体外观、航向和运动方式与先前一次目击相似；它先保持稳定位置，随后缓慢远离。

**行为：** 约2302时该物体停止移动，之后沿 130° 真方位缓慢移动，约2305时仍基本稳定，随后逐渐消失到星空背景中。

**注：** 此页是更完整报告的便笺摘要，但明确记录了一次具体目击事件。

events.title: White light observed near Palmerston North at dusk
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A civilian man in Palmerston North reported the event, first alerted by his 13-year-old son; his wife and mother also watched it.

**Sighting:** Around 1850 on a Saturday evening, he stepped outside after his son said there was a light in the sky.

**Object:** A steady white light moved slowly left-to-right against a dark cloudy sky, then appeared as a small ball of fire or disc-like light when viewed through binoculars.

**Tactics:** The light first held a true bearing near 080°, later slowed, shifted toward 130°, and climbed from about 25° to 35° above the horizon before its motion ceased.

**Note:** The witness compared it to aircraft but said it lacked normal aircraft characteristics and was not consistent with a mirage.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名居住在帕默斯顿北的平民男子报告了这次事件，最初是他的13岁儿子提醒他；他的妻子和母亲也一起看到了。

**目击经过：** 1979年4月21日星期六约1850时，他在儿子说天空里有一束光后走到屋外。

**物体：** 在黑暗多云的天空中，一个稳定的白光缓慢地从左向右移动；用双筒望远镜看时，似乎像一个小火球或圆盘状的光。

**轨迹/行为：** 该光最初的真方位约为080°，随后减速并转向130°左右，仰角从约25°升至35°，之后停止移动。

**备注：** 目击者将其与飞机作比较，但认为它缺乏正常飞机特征，也不像海市蜃楼。

events.title: Night light observed over Palmerston North, moving from Aokautere toward Hokowhitu
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A father in Palmerston North reported the event after his 13-year-old son first noticed a light outside their house.

**Sighting:** At about 1850 hours on Saturday 21 April 1979, the boy saw a steady white light in the twilight sky; the father stepped outside and watched it with him.

**Object:** Through binoculars it appeared as a circular, unblinking naked flame or disc-like light, with a small red light to one side/above, and it was not like a normal aircraft or a mirror reflection.

**Tactics:** It moved slowly from left to right, on a steady heading, with the apparent elevation increasing from about 25° to 35°; the observer estimated it passed from Aokautere toward Hokowhitu, over the Manawatū River area.

**Note:** The writer compared it to an aircraft but concluded it had none of the usual characteristics of known aircraft lights.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一位住在北帕默斯顿的父亲报告了这起事件，最先发现的是他13岁的儿子，之后父亲也一起观察，后来妻子和母亲也看到了。

**目击经过：** 1979年4月21日星期六约18:50，男孩在黄昏天空中看到一道稳定的白光；父亲走到室外与他一同观看。

**物体：** 通过双筒望远镜看去，它像一个不闪烁的裸火或圆盘状光源，旁边/上方还有一小团红光，看起来不像普通飞机或镜面反射。

**行动轨迹：** 它缓慢地从左向右移动，航向稳定，仰角似乎从约25°升至35°；目击者估计它从Aokautere方向飞向Hokowhitu，经过马纳瓦图河上空。

**注：** 叙述者曾联想到飞机，但认为它不具备任何已知飞机灯光的典型特征。

events.title: RNZAF radar contact on patrol north of Auckland
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** RNZAF crew on a north-bound patrol at 9,000 ft, with the AEO and radar operator specifically named as assessors of the contact.

**Sighting:** At 0350 on 9 April 1979, radar picked up a contact in position 37°10′S 171°30′W (as written), bearing 116/20 nm from the aircraft. The crew homed on it and the target was sectorised and seen on the tilt control below the aircraft.

**Object:** It appeared as a light-medium cloud, roughly 3 nm long and 1 nm wide, with no observable movement; the contact was lost and regained during homing.

**Tactics:** Multiple homings on "On Top" failed to reveal anything above or below the target, leading the crew to believe it was a cloud contact at about 404 nm true range.

**Note:** The memo concludes the radar behaviour was consistent with atmospheric ducting and a cloud return rather than a solid object.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 新西兰皇家空军（RNZAF）巡逻机组人员，尤其是空中电子官（AEO）和雷达操作员对该目标进行了判断。

**目击经过：** 1979年4月9日03:50，在9,000英尺高度进行北向巡逻时，雷达在所写位置37°10′S 171°30′W（原文如此）探测到一个目标，方位116度，距机约20海里。机组随后进行引导追踪，目标被分区扫描，并通过俯仰控制观察到位于飞机下方。

**物体：** 它看起来像一团浅至中等密度的云，约3海里长、1海里宽，没有明显移动；追踪过程中目标一度丢失又重新出现。

**战术：** 机组多次以“On Top”方式追踪，但在目标上方和下方都未发现可解释的实体，因此认为它是约404海里的真实距离处的云回波。

**备注：** 备忘录结论认为，该雷达现象与大气波导和云层回波一致，而非实体物体。

events.title: Three UFOs observed from Woodbourne control tower
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** W/O I.B. Uffindell says he and Mr Bill Frame observed the objects from the Woodbourne control tower.

**Sighting:** On Monday 22 January 1979 they watched the event for about one hour and took bearings and elevations.

**Object:** Three UFOs were reportedly seen; the letter gives no shape, colour, or motion details beyond the count and duration.

**Tactics:** The author says they recorded angular data and intended to forward it to the inquiry committee.

**Note:** This page is a complaint letter about the Defence Investigation Committee’s handling of earlier Marlborough coast sightings, but it includes a concrete sighting report from Woodbourne.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** W/O I.B. Uffindell 表示他与 Bill Frame 先生在 Woodbourne 控制塔内目击了这些物体。

**目击经过：** 1979 年 1 月 22 日（星期一），他们持续观察约一小时，并测量了方位与仰角。

**物体：** 据称看见了 3 个 UFO；页面未提供其形状、颜色或运动细节，仅说明数量与持续时间。

**方式：** 作者称他们记录了角度数据，并打算提交给调查委员会。

**备注：** 此页主要是一封批评调查委员会处理先前马尔堡海岸目击事件的投诉信，但其中包含一则具体的 Woodbourne 目击报告。
